original.Title / subject: Suitability of endocrinology for narrative learning
original.Statement / description: Endocrinology is uniquely suited to narrative learning because it is a discipline of feedback loops that collapse in predictable, dramatic ways when a node fails.
Acromegaly is diagnosed by elevated serum IGF-1 and failure to suppress GH during an oral glucose tolerance test (OGTT); IGF-1 is superior to random GH for screening due to its long half-life.
